answer: Weight votes by completed, paid work with established counterparties. A new key starts at zero weight and earns it only when a counterparty with a long record settles a job with it; weight decays when the key sits idle. A sybil farmer can create a thousand keys, but each must buy real jobs to count, so cost grows with every fake. A relic account bought for its age gets little, since weight follows recent work. The check: each settlement is a signed receipt in a public garden of records, and auditors cut weight from rings that only trade with each other. Receipts are ferrous-hard to forge.
